topPRs.title: sep/125: U21 OPCM migrate for Unichain Sepolia + OP Sepolia (the interop set)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Draft U21 (`op-contracts/v9.0.0`) interop migration of **Unichain Sepolia and OP Sepolia**: one `OPCM.migrate` for the pair with `OPCMMigrateV900`, stacked on #1602 (sep/115, which this PR is based on) and merging #1582 for the template (retarget once those land). Ink Sepolia and Soneium Minato are upgraded by 115 and never migrated.

| Task | Template | Chains | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sep/125-U21-op-uni-opcm-migrate-v900` | `OPCMMigrateV900` | Unichain Sepolia (1301), OP Sepolia (11155420) | `DEPENDS_ON` 115; ascending chain-ID order, so Unichain's ProxyAdmin administers the shared proxies |

**Inputs (read on-chain 3 Nov, both chains at v8: SystemConfig 4.0.0, `lastUsedOPCMVersion` 8.0.1, respected game 9, own lockbox each):**
- Proposer: OP Sepolia's OPE proposer `0x9884…35f5` (sep/113, `DisputeGameFactory.gameArgs(5)`). Unichain Sepolia's op-proposer `0x97e7…0800` must be stopped or repointed after migration, and OP Sepolia's proposer configured for the interop set.
- Super root `0x382d95f5…9a08` @ 1793742186 from `op-chain-ops/cmd/check-super-root` over `sepolia.unichain.org` + `sepolia.optimism.io` at the latest common finalized timestamp; **refresh before signing** and regenerate hashes.
- Prestate `0x03b985…faf59` (kona-client/v1.9.0 interop, same as 115), game type 9, 0.08 ETH bond, OPCM `0x160f…39cc` (v9.0.0-rc.1, 9.0.3; swap if the final release redeploys it).
- Nonces pinned one above 115's (L1PAO 60 / FUS 83 / SC 74). sep/116 and sep/118 pin the same safes.

**Checks:** `just simulate-stack sep 125-U21-op-uni-opcm-migrate-v900 council` on top of 115 passed on 3 Nov (Sepolia block ~12058200) with empty validator output for both chains; `VALIDATION.md` has both child-safe hashes, the root Safe tx hash and the full calldata. State-change section is descriptive; per-slot Tenderly review still to do before READY TO SIGN. sep/121 (the same call on Jacob's devnet pair) cost 17.0M gas on Sepolia, so `TENDERLY_GAS` is 30M.

Open before un-drafting: final v9.0.0 OPCM address, the super root refresh, Tenderly slot review, Security review of the template PRs, and confirmation that OP + Unichain is the whole Sepolia interop set (the migrate scope is not written in the records yet).

topPRs.title: feat(template): add OPCMUpgradeV900
topPRs.author: ZakAyesh
topPRs.body:
Adds `OPCMUpgradeV900`, the upgrade half of the v9 (interop) release: it calls `OPContractsManagerV2.upgradeSuperchain` once, then `upgrade` per chain, so a set of chains already on op-contracts/v8 steps onto the v9 OPCM.

**Ordering:** this task runs before the `OPCMMigrateV900` task in #1582. `migrate` requires every chain to already be on the v9 OPCM.

Differences from `OPCMUpgradeV800`, all driven by the v9 OPCM:
- The only permitted upgrade instruction is `overrides.cfg.startingRespectedGameType`; the `startingAnchorRoot` override is rejected, so the anchor-root inputs are gone and the super-root anchor is carried forward. `_validate` asserts the respected game type landed and the anchor was not cleared.
- Version gate accepts any 9.x and checks `isPermittedUpgradeSequence` per chain.
- SUPER_CANNON_KONA is enabled when the factory already carries it (v8 cleared the CANNON_KONA impl it used to key off).
- `Challenger` is read with a tolerant lookup: super-game-only chains register none.

**Example task and simulation.** `sep/045-opcm-upgrade-v900` (Unichain Sepolia + OP Sepolia) simulates against the throwaway v9 OPCM (9.0.5) Andrea deployed on Sepolia on 2026-10-22 for template testing (`0xe09c417496c786abffefa676da9e11aab2c32ea9`, not an rc, no tag, no registry entry). The simulation passes end to end at fork block 11999987 with no validator errors for either chain. A real task must point at the released v9 OPCM. The example is not skipped in `simulate-all-templates`, so CI depends on that throwaway contract staying deployed; happy to add a skip like #1582 if preferred.

Setup tests: `test/template/OPCMUpgradeV900Setup.t.sol` (5 tests, Sepolia fork).

Open for review: the prestate in the example is the chains' current SUPER_CANNON_KONA prestate as a placeholder, and the ZK game path is unsupported as in V800.

topPRs.title: sep/122-123: U21 upgrade tasks for sepolia-devnet-2/3/4/5 and -6 (placeholders for 5 and 6)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Draft U21 (`op-contracts/v9.0.0`) upgrade tasks for the OP Labs staging networks, with placeholders where the inputs don't exist yet. **U21 is upgrade only (decided 3 Nov):** the devnet-4 + -5 `OPCM.migrate` follows the U22 / op-contracts v10.0.0 upgrade as a separate task, so sep/124 was dropped from this PR. Stacked on #1582 (which is stacked on #1591) for the `OPCMUpgradeV900` / `OPCMMigrateV900` templates; retarget to `main` once those merge.

| Task | Template | Chains | Why separate |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sep/122-U21-sepolia-devnet-4-5-opcm-upgrade-v900` | `OPCMUpgradeV900` | sepolia-devnet-2 (420130015), -3 (420130018), -4 (420130019), -5 (420130020) | all share the devnet SuperchainConfig `0x289d…1DBb` |
| `sep/123-U21-sepolia-devnet-6-opcm-upgrade-v900` | `OPCMUpgradeV900` | sepolia-devnet-6 (420130021) | own SuperchainConfig, so it can't sit in 122 (the template requires one SuperchainConfig per task); custom gas token, permissioned (5), never migrated |

All three run from the staging ProxyAdminOwner Safe `0xe934…40ff` (1-of-1, nonce 155 today; pinned 155/156/157) through the v9.0.0-rc.1 Sepolia OPCM `0x160f0fe4dc1b3f4026687e8dd4b7f800879939cc` (9.0.3, superchain-registry `41553edc`), the same way sep/107 used the standard v8 OPCM for devnet-2/3 (`SYSCON-130` is an expected validator error on the devnet SuperchainConfig).

**Real values:** devnet-2 and -3 from the registry; devnet-4's addresses in `122/addresses.json`, from `stg/sepolia-devnet-4/op-deployer/state.json` (devnets-private #2388) and read back on-chain: SystemConfig 4.0.0 / `lastUsedOPCMVersion` 8.0.1, respected game type 9, games 5 and 9 registered (0.08 ETH bond), no ETHLockbox wired, `isPermittedUpgradeSequence` true on the rc1 OPCM. A scratch simulation of 122 with devnet-5 removed passed at Sepolia block ~12057700: validator output `OVERRIDES-L1PAOMULTISIG,SYSCON-130` on devnet-2 and -4, plus `SCKDG-SHAPE,SCKDG-10` on devnet-3, as recorded in the config. devnet-3 runs only SUPER_PERMISSIONED, so discovery registers no DelayedWETH for it; it is pinned as `PermissionedWETH` in `[addresses]` (same workaround as eth/084 for Soneium; flagged on #1591).

**Placeholders (`0xdead…dead`), to fill in before simulating the real tasks:**
- sepolia-devnet-5 addresses (devnets-private #2365 not deployed) and all of sepolia-devnet-6's (#2366; it also needs its own v7 and v8 tasks first, not in this PR).
- The U21 kona interop prestate for the devnet-4/5 cluster (`netchef fault-proofs generate-prestates --prestate-type konaInterop`); devnet-2 uses the standard kona-client/v1.9.0 interop prestate since it stays standalone.
- 124's super proposer and the pair's honest super root (`check-super-root`).
- VALIDATION.md hashes, calldata and state diffs are `TODO`.

**CI:** `stacked_simulation_sep` will fail on this PR until the placeholders are replaced, since `fetch-tasks.sh` includes DRAFT tasks.

topPRs.title: sep/110 + eth/074: Unichain SystemConfig owner to Foundation Upgrade Safe
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Transfers ownership of the Unichain Sepolia and Unichain Mainnet `SystemConfigProxy` from the Unichain SystemConfig owner Safes to the Foundation Upgrade Safe, ahead of the Unichain migration cutovers. 

Each task is a single `SystemConfig.transferOwnership(address)` call executed by the current owner: `0x325B777f8F0bC71fb6b617Bc41A8703CA7077891` on Sepolia and `0x9245d5D10AA8a842B31530De71EA86c0760Ca1b1` on Mainnet.

Both tasks use the `TransferSystemConfigOwnership` template (used already for tasks eth/065 and sep/104 - Ink transfer) with `safeAddressString = "SystemConfigOwner"` so the signer is the owner discovered on chain.

| Task | SystemConfigProxy | New owner | Nonce pin |
|---|---|---|---|
| sep/110 | `0xaeE94b9aB7752D3F7704bDE212c0C6A0b701571D` | `0xDEe57160aAfCF04c34C887B5962D0a69676d3C8B` (Sepolia FUS) | 7 |
| eth/074 | `0xc407398d063f942feBbcC6F80a156b47F3f1BDA6` | `0x847B5c174615B1B7fDF770882256e2D3E95b9D92` (FUS) | 11 |

Nonces are the live values on 2026-10-01

topPRs.title: eth/084: U21 (op-contracts/v9.0.0) OPCM upgrade for OP Mainnet, Ink, Soneium and Unichain
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Upgrade 21 on the four OP-governed Mainnet chains with `OPCMUpgradeV900`, stacked on #1591 for the template (retarget to `main` once it merges). Upgrade only: U21 runs no `OPCM.migrate` (decided 3 Nov); the OP + Unichain migration follows U22 / op-contracts v10.0.0 as its own task.

- OPCM: `op-contracts/v9.0.0-rc.1` Mainnet `0x2d91e6f2bcf6cd1df90e1faf9714e18705ea331f` (9.0.3, superchain-registry `41553edc`). Swap if the final v9.0.0 redeploys it.
- OP Mainnet, Ink and Unichain stay on SUPER_CANNON_KONA (9) with the kona-client/v1.9.0 `cannon64-kona-interop` prestate `0x03b985…faf59` (the one the U21 notice page lists); Soneium stays permissioned (5) with game 9 disabled (`SCKDG-SHAPE,SCKDG-10` expected, as in eth/071). Anchors carried forward; every chain already has an ETHLockbox, so no ETH moves.
- Nonces pinned after the pending stack: eth/082 (+1 FUS) and eth/083 (+1 all three) → L1PAO 49 / FUS 81 / SC 76.
- Simulated both nested paths locally at block 26336492, stacked on 082 and 083: validator errors empty on OP/Ink/Unichain, `SCKDG-SHAPE,SCKDG-10` on Soneium. Two task-level workarounds the simulation forced:
  - Soneium's SystemConfig now packs a non-zero `minBaseFee` in slot `0x6c` → same `storageCodeExceptions` entry as Unichain.
  - Soneium runs only SUPER_PERMISSIONED since U20, so discovery registers no `PermissionedWETH`/`PermissionlessWETH` for it and the DelayedWETH re-initialization was rejected; pinned its DelayedWETH as `PermissionedWETH` in `[addresses]`. Flagged on #1591: the template should allow `SystemConfig.delayedWETH()` per chain instead.
- `VALIDATION.md` has both child-safe hashes, the root Safe tx hash, the full calldata and per-chain proposers. The state-change section is descriptive; per-slot Tenderly review still to do before READY TO SIGN.

Open items before un-drafting: final v9.0.0 OPCM address, prestate confirmation (govpost draft says "unchanged", notice page says kona v1.9.0), Tenderly slot review, governance approval, Security review of the template PRs.
